visualCharacteristics.purpose: event photo gallery: a sliding row of photos (3 per view on desktop) with prev/next arrows and page dots; clicking a photo opens it enlarged in a lightbox

contentPattern.structure: one row per photo; cell 1 = image; optional cell 2 = caption text. Rows without an image or text are dropped; with one page of photos the arrows and dots are hidden

usage: Community event pages showing a strip of event photos.
reuseGuidance: Use for image-only galleries. For rotating story heroes with headline and CTA use carousel-hero.
